title: The Bind Master's Companion
summary: A companion for those past the primers that adds the master shackle and a crush that ends a hold in a blow.

title: A Treatise on the Patient Knot
summary: A treatise on knots that tighten slowly over many breaths and end in a cinch the opponent cannot break.

title: The Azure Cordage Course
summary: A course of the azure sky that plaits cords of soul force into a net and drops the net over a whole group.

title: Manual of the Skyward Lash
summary: A manual of lashes thrown high and left hanging so that a soul that rises or leaps is caught in the air.

title: The Gale-Borne Fetter Canon
summary: A canon of the gale that throws fetters on a fast gust of soul force and closes them before the opponent can turn.

title: A Wind-Sworn Knot Course
summary: A short oath-course that ties each knot to a spoken troth and teaches how to untie an ally from a forced vow.
